description.narrative: Stöd genom Trócaire till ett MR-konsortium för stöd i olika former till MR-försvarare och offer för MR-överträdelser; för monitorering och rapportering av MR-överträdelser; för stöd till och kapacitetsutveckling av rättighetsbärare och organisationer. Särskilt fokus på kvinnor och ungdomar.

Support through Trócaire to a human rights consortium för support in different forms to human rights defenders and victims of human rights abuse; for monitoring and reporting of human rights abuse; for support to and capacity building of rights holders and organisations. Special focus on women and youth.

Trócaire is working together with a Consortium of local civil society partners. The project has two overall outcomes: 1. Duty bearers are challenged by organised citizens to respect and protect human rights. 2. Reduced barriers to gender equality in civil and political rights.

Legal support was provided in 414 cases, benefitting 1 045 persons (605 males, 440 females).
Medical support was provided to 529 people (330 males, 199 females), 532 persons (326 males, 206 females) received psychosocial support.
The project recorded 1 405 incidents of human rights violations, affecting almost 39 000 victims (21 676 males, 17 259 females).
More than 12 200 individuals were actively participating in human rights advocacy in different forms. These engagements resulted in 30 issue-based advocacy actions at community level - covering the following issues: public service delivery, right to education, forced displacements, land invasions/environmental issues, social inclusion, right to health and access to documentation.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
